correctness.rationale: For every n>=3 and finite field of characteristic three, the exact polynomial det(tI-A)=(t+1)^(n-2) g_n(t) is checked against the published formula and reconstructed directly. A dimension calculation for the exceptional n=1 mod 3 case proves one length-three minus-one adjacency Jordan chain and n-3 length-one chains. Temporal companion Smith forms give length-six, length-two, and negative length-two Jordan blocks; in the other two classes the mod-three sixth-degree wave factors have orders 28 and 4/8. These reproduce the sharp periods and all fixed-space dimensions. The actual packaged standard-library checker passed all modular rank/power tests for n=3..18 and independently enumerated all states for n=3,4,5. The all-size result follows from the algebraic proof, not extrapolation.

value.rationale: The one-leaf perturbation is a canonical graph operation on maximally connected graphs; the unexpected primitive order-28 factor changes the sharp clock from 9 to 84 for n divisible by three. The three-residue classification and the exact fixed-iterate formula for every field extension distinguish semisimple and defective characteristic-three sectors. The precise temporal orbit population is an independently useful dynamical invariant; it is not just an arbitrary finite example or an unmotivated spectral restatement.
